computer-cyber.title: Guide to Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response
computer-cyber.author: Karen Kent et al. / NIST
computer-cyber.use: Read for evidence collection, examination, analysis and reporting concepts.

computer-cyber.title: Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management
computer-cyber.author: Alexander Nelson et al. / NIST
computer-cyber.use: Connect findings and evidence handling to a wider incident response process.

computer-cyber.title: Guide to Malware Incident Prevention and Handling for Desktops and Laptops
computer-cyber.author: Murugiah Souppaya and Karen Scarfone / NIST
computer-cyber.use: Understand defensive handling and evidence context; the PFSA lab contains no live malware.

mobile.title: Guidelines on Mobile Device Forensics
mobile.author: Richard Ayers, Sam Brothers and Wayne Jansen / NIST
mobile.use: Distinguish preservation, acquisition, examination and reporting; account for the age of device examples.

mobile.title: Guidelines for Managing the Security of Mobile Devices in the Enterprise
mobile.author: Gema Howell et al. / NIST
mobile.use: Understand device lifecycle, management context and privacy boundaries.

mobile.title: Vetting the Security of Mobile Applications
mobile.author: Michael Ogata et al. / NIST
mobile.use: Learn how app assessment claims need a defined scope and evidence; this is background reading, not an app exploitation lab.

network.title: An Introduction to Computer Networks
network.author: Peter L. Dordal
network.use: Study IP, DNS, transport protocols and the meaning of flow metadata.

network.title: Wireshark User's Guide
network.author: Wireshark contributors / Wireshark Foundation
network.use: Read interface and offline-analysis chapters; live capture is outside the supplied CSV lab.

network.title: Guide to Computer Security Log Management
network.author: Karen Kent and Murugiah Souppaya / NIST
network.use: Understand log collection, retention, timestamp context and review limitations.

cloud.title: NIST Cloud Computing Forensic Reference Architecture
cloud.author: Martin Herman et al. / NIST
cloud.use: Map forensic readiness and responsibility boundaries to a cloud evidence case.

cloud.title: NIST Cloud Computing Forensic Science Challenges
cloud.author: Martin Herman et al. / NIST
cloud.use: Identify gaps caused by tenancy, retention, time and provider visibility.

cloud.title: Guidelines on Security and Privacy in Public Cloud Computing
cloud.author: Wayne Jansen and Timothy Grance / NIST
cloud.use: Build foundational context for provider responsibilities and evidence scope; consult current provider documentation for product details.

database.title: Database Design - 2nd Edition
database.author: Adrienne Watt and contributors / BCcampus
database.use: Study relational design, keys, integrity and SQL concepts.

database.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation
database.author: PostgreSQL Global Development Group
database.use: Read the SQL tutorial and transaction concepts; PostgreSQL syntax is not automatically valid in the SQLite exercise.

database.title: Foundations of Databases
database.author: Serge Abiteboul, Richard Hull and Victor Vianu
database.use: Use the full PDF link on the authors page for personal study of relational models, keys and dependencies. The authors permit a personal copy but prohibit redistribution.

iot.title: Introduction to Embedded Systems: A Cyber-Physical Systems Approach
iot.author: Edward A. Lee and Sanjit A. Seshia
iot.use: Study models, time and interactions between computing and physical processes.

iot.title: The Internet of Things: An Overview
iot.author: Karen Rose, Scott Eldridge and Lyman Chapin / Internet Society
iot.use: Read about IoT communication models, interoperability and privacy context.

iot.title: IoT Device Cybersecurity Capability Core Baseline
iot.author: Michael Fagan et al. / NIST
iot.use: Relate device identification, configuration and state awareness to an evidence inventory.
